title: Craftisle vs Alternatives — How We Compare to Other Tool Platforms
description: Honest comparison of Craftisle vs popular alternatives. See how our privacy-first, no-signup approach compares to other online tool platforms. Detailed feature breakdown.

body.raw:
Choosing the right online tool platform matters — especially when you're processing sensitive documents, code, or personal data. Here's how Craftisle compares to popular alternatives across the features that matter most.

## The Comparison Matrix

| Feature | Craftisle | TinyWow | iLovePDF | Convertio | SmallPDF |
|---------|-----------|---------|----------|-----------|----------|
| **Account Required** | No | No | No | No | Yes (limits) |
| **Privacy (Client-Side)** | ✅ Full | ⚠️ Partial | ❌ Server | ❌ Server | ❌ Server |
| **PDF Tools Count** | 67 | 20+ | 20+ | 15+ | 20+ |
| **Image Tools** | 17 | 10+ | 0 | 5+ | 0 |
| **Dev Tools** | 28 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| **Free Forever** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ⚠️ Limited | ⚠️ Limited |
| **Open Source** | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Offline Support** | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **File Viewer (100+ formats)** | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Resume Builder** | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Resource Directory** | ✅ (10K+) | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Games** | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |

## Deep Dive Comparisons

### Craftisle vs TinyWow

**TinyWow strengths:**
- Polished UI with modern design
- Good coverage of common PDF and image tasks
- Fast processing for small files

**Craftisle advantages:**
- **67 PDF tools vs 20+** — Much deeper PDF capabilities (OCR, digital signatures, PDF/A, booklet maker, etc.)
- **Developer tools** — TinyWow has zero developer tools. Craftisle has 28.
- **True client-side processing** — TinyWow uploads files to their server. Craftisle processes locally.
- **100+ format file viewer** — TinyWow has no universal file viewer.
- **Open source** — You can audit Craftisle's code or self-host it.

**Best for:** Craftisle if you need dev tools, maximum privacy, or advanced PDF features. TinyWow if you prefer a more polished UI and only need basic tools.

### Craftisle vs iLovePDF

**iLovePDF strengths:**
- Well-known brand with desktop and mobile apps
- Good OCR quality
- API for developers

**Craftisle advantages:**
- **Privacy** — iLovePDF uploads files to their servers. Craftisle processes locally.
- **Broader tool set** — iLovePDF only does PDF. Craftisle adds image tools, dev tools, and more.
- **No limits** — iLovePDF has file size and daily usage limits on the free tier.
- **No account** — iLovePDF pushes account creation. Craftisle never asks.

**Best for:** Craftisle for privacy-focused users and those needing more than just PDF tools. iLovePDF if you specifically need their mobile app or API integration.

### Craftisle vs Convertio

**Convertio strengths:**
- Huge format conversion library (300+ formats)
- Good for obscure file format conversions
- Chrome extension available

**Craftisle advantages:**
- **No 100MB limit** — Convertio's free tier is limited to 100MB. Craftisle has no limits.
- **Client-side processing** — Convertio processes on their servers.
- **Always free** — Convertio has daily conversion limits on free tier.
- **Additional tools** — Convertio only converts. Craftisle offers 135+ tools across all categories.

**Best for:** Craftisle for everyday tool needs with unlimited usage. Convertio if you specifically need to convert a very obscure format that Craftisle doesn't support.

## Why "Client-Side" Is the Killer Feature

The fundamental difference between Craftisle and most alternatives is the processing architecture:

**Server-side processing (most competitors):**
1. You upload your file to their server
2. Their server processes it
3. You download the result
4. (They may or may not delete your file)

**Client-side processing (Craftisle):**
1. Your browser reads the file locally
2. JavaScript/WebAssembly processes it in your browser's memory
3. The result is saved directly to your downloads

This matters because:
- **NDAs and confidential documents** — You can't upload a legal contract to a random server
- **GDPR/HIPAA compliance** — Client-side processing simplifies compliance
- **Large files** — No upload wait time for multi-GB files
- **Offline use** — Tools work without internet after initial load

## The Craftisle Guarantee

We don't compete on being the biggest or having the most features. We compete on being the platform you can **trust with your data** because we never have it in the first place.

All Craftisle tools are and will remain:
- Free — no premium tiers, no usage limits, no paywalls
- Private — client-side processing wherever possible
- Open — source code available on GitHub
- No signup — never an account wall

Start exploring at [craftisle.com/tools](/tools) and compare for yourself.

title: Developer Tools on Craftisle — Formatters, Encryption, Converters & More
description: 28 free developer tools for everyday coding. JSON/SQL/YAML formatters, AES/bcrypt encryption, Base64 conversion, regex testing, JWT decoding, Cron expressions, and QR generation.

body.raw:
Every developer needs a toolkit of reliable utilities they can reach for without friction. Craftisle's developer tools provide exactly that — **28 free, browser-based tools** covering encryption, formatting, conversion, testing, and generation. No installs, no accounts, no limits.

## Encryption & Hashing (4 tools)

### AES/DES Encrypt
Full symmetric encryption with support for AES and DES algorithms. Choose between ECB and CBC modes with 128/192/256-bit keys. Encrypt and decrypt text or files entirely in your browser.

**Use case:** Encrypt configuration values, API keys, or sensitive data before storage.

### Bcrypt Hash
Industry-standard password hashing with adjustable cost factor. Generate bcrypt hashes for authentication systems. Verify passwords against existing hashes.

**Use case:** Hash passwords during development or generate test data for auth systems.

### Hash Tool
Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, and RIPEMD-160 hashes. File hashing with drag-and-drop support. Verify file integrity or generate checksums.

**Use case:** Verify downloaded file integrity or generate content hashes.

### JWT Decoder
Decode JSON Web Tokens to inspect header, payload, and signature. View claims, expiration, and issuer information. Validate token structure.

**Use case:** Debug authentication issues or inspect API tokens during development.

## Formatters (5 tools)

### JSON Formatter
Beautify, minify, and validate JSON with tree view navigation. Collapsible nodes for large objects. Copy formatted output with one click. **Most popular tool on Craftisle.**

### HTML Formatter
Format HTML code with proper indentation. Supports JSX syntax. Minify option for production optimization.

### SQL Formatter
Format SQL queries with configurable keyword casing (UPPER/lower). Handles nested queries, CTEs, and complex joins.

### YAML Formatter
Validate and format YAML. Perfect for Kubernetes manifests, GitHub Actions workflows, and Docker Compose files.

### HTML Escape
Escape and unescape HTML special characters. Essential for preventing XSS vulnerabilities and encoding user-generated content.

## Converters (9 tools)

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **Base64 Encode/Decode** | Text and file encoding with instant preview |
| **Base32 Encode** | Base32 encoding for legacy systems |
| **Base58 Encode** | Bitcoin/IPFS-style encoding without ambiguous characters |
| **Radix Converter** | Convert between bases 2-36 with live preview |
| **CSV ↔ JSON** | Bidirectional conversion with custom delimiters |
| **URL Encode/Decode** | Percent-encoding for URLs and query parameters |
| **Image to Base64** | Embed images as data URIs for HTML/CSS |
| **PNG to SVG** | Raster to vector conversion via edge detection |
| **PDF Tools** | External link to [pdf.craftisle.com](https://pdf.craftisle.com) |

## Developer Tools (7 tools)

### Cron Expression Builder
Interactive cron expression editor with human-readable preview. See exactly when your cron job will run next. Supports standard 5-field cron syntax.

### Regex Tester
Real-time regular expression testing with match highlighting. View captured groups, match positions, and test against sample text.

### Regex Visualizer
**5-star rated tool.** Visualize regex patterns as interactive AST diagrams. Understand complex regex by seeing the parse tree and character classes visually.

### Mermaid Chart Editor
Create flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, class diagrams, and more using Mermaid syntax. Live preview with PNG/SVG export.

### SVG Editor
Write SVG code with real-time preview. Edit paths, shapes, and attributes with instant visual feedback.

### HTML Visual Editor
WYSIWYG HTML editor with live preview. Edit HTML and see the rendered output simultaneously.

### File Viewer
External link to [viewer.craftisle.com](https://viewer.craftisle.com) — preview 100+ file formats online.

## Generators (7 tools)

## What is Craftisle?

Craftisle is a comprehensive **free online tools platform** that brings together 135+ browser-based utilities across 4 specialized products. Every tool runs entirely in your browser — no data is ever uploaded to a server, no signup is required, and everything is free forever.

## The Four Products

### 1. Craftisle Main Site (craftisle.com)

The flagship platform hosts **62 built-in tools** across 10 categories:

| Category | Tool Count | Highlights |
|----------|-----------|------------|
| **Image** | 17 tools | Resize, crop, compress, convert, watermark, meme generator, favicon maker, beautify screenshots |
| **Encryption & Hashing** | 4 tools | AES/DES encrypt, bcrypt hash, SHA/MD5 hash, JWT decoder |
| **Formatters** | 5 tools | JSON, HTML, SQL, YAML formatter, HTML escape |
| **Converters** | 9 tools | Base64/32/58, CSV↔JSON, URL encode, image-to-base64, radix converter |
| **Developer Tools** | 7 tools | Cron expression builder, regex tester & visualizer, mermaid charts, SVG editor, HTML visual editor |
| **Generators** | 7 tools | QR code, UUID, lorem ipsum, random string, pixel art, handwriting animation |
| **Text Tools** | 4 tools | Case converter, diff checker, unicode lookup, text formatter |
| **Network Tools** | 3 tools | IP calculator & radix converter, user-agent parser |
| **Utilities** | 7 tools | Pomodoro timer, countdown, stopwatch, coin flip, wheel spinner, scoreboard |
| **Other** | Extras | Barcode generator, color picker, keyboard tester, markdown editor, TTS |

### 2. PDF Tools (pdf.craftisle.com)

A dedicated **67-tool PDF processing suite** built on pdf-lib and qpdf.wasm. All processing happens client-side via WebAssembly, meaning your sensitive documents never leave your device.

**Organize & Manage (24 tools):** Merge, split, extract pages, organize, delete pages, OCR, alternate merge, add/extract attachments, rotate, overlay, N-up layout, grid combine, booklet maker.

**Edit & Annotate (16 tools):** Full PDF editor, sign, crop, bookmark, table of contents, page numbers, watermark, header/footer, invert colors, stamps, form filler & creator, remove annotations.

**Convert to PDF (18 tools):** Convert from JPG, PNG, WebP, SVG, BMP, HEIC, TIFF, Word, Excel, PPT, EPUB, MOBI, Markdown, email, and more.

**Convert from PDF (13 tools):** Export to JPG, PNG, WebP, TIFF, SVG, Word, Excel, PPT, JSON, Markdown, CBZ, extract images, extract tables.

**Optimize & Repair (10 tools):** Compress, fix page size, linearize, repair, deskew, PDF/A conversion, font to outline, OCG layer management.

**Secure (9 tools):** Encrypt, decrypt, sanitize, redact, flatten, remove metadata, change permissions, digital sign, validate signature, timestamp.

### 3. File Viewer (viewer.craftisle.com)

Preview **100+ file formats** directly in your browser — no installation needed. Five specialized viewers:

- **PDF Viewer** — Full PDF rendering with zoom, rotation, search
- **DOCX Viewer** — Word documents with formatting preserved
- **XLSX Viewer** — Excel spreadsheets with formula support
- **PPTX Viewer** — PowerPoint presentations with animations
- **3D & CAD Viewer** — STL, OBJ, GLTF, DWG, DXF, and more

Also supports images (PNG, JPG, SVG, WebP, PSD, AI), code files (JSON, XML, YAML, HTML, CSS, JS, TS, Python), and data formats (CSV, TSV).

### 4. Resume Builder (resume.craftisle.com)

A **privacy-first resume creation tool** built on Reactive Resume. All data stays in your browser's localStorage — no account required.

- Rich text editing with 15+ section types
- Multiple professional templates
- Real-time preview
- Export to PDF and DOCX
- Keyboard shortcuts for efficient editing
- Dark/light theme support

## Why Craftisle?

**Privacy First** — All processing is client-side. No file uploads, no server storage, no data collection.

**No Signup** — Every tool works immediately. No accounts, no email verification, no friction.

**Free Forever** — The entire platform is free. No premium tiers, no paywalls, no usage limits.

**Fast & Reliable** — WebAssembly and modern browser APIs deliver desktop-class performance.

**Always Improving** — New tools and features are added regularly based on user feedback.

## Getting Started

Visit [craftisle.com/tools](/tools) to browse the full tool catalog, or jump directly to any of the specialized subdomains:

- [PDF Tools](https://pdf.craftisle.com) — 67 PDF utilities
- [File Viewer](https://viewer.craftisle.com) — 100+ format preview
- [Resume Builder](https://resume.craftisle.com) — Professional resumes

title: Free Online Games on Craftisle — Island Builder, World Builder & More
description: Play free HTML5 games instantly on Craftisle. Mykos Island Builder, Tiny World Builder — no download, no install, play directly in your browser. More games coming soon.

body.raw:
Craftisle Games brings free, instantly playable HTML5 games to your browser. No downloads, no installations, no signups — just click and play.

## Available Games

### Mykos Island Builder

Build your dream island in this creative sandbox game. Inspired by the Greek island of Mykonos, you'll design landscapes, construct buildings, and watch your island come to life.

**What you can do:**
- **Terrain sculpting** — Raise mountains, carve valleys, shape coastlines
- **Building placement** — Houses, lighthouses, windmills, and more
- **Vegetation** — Plant trees, flowers, and gardens
- **Path networks** — Connect your island with roads and trails
- **Dynamic water** — Realistic water edges that adapt to your terrain

**Why it's special:** Mykos Island Builder isn't just a game — it's a creative tool. Use it as a visual brainstorming platform for:
- Landscape architecture concepts
- World-building for stories and D&D campaigns
- Relaxation and mindfulness through creative play
- Teaching basic geography and urban planning concepts

### Tiny World Builder

Create miniature worlds with endless creative possibilities:

- **Modular building system** — Snap together pre-designed pieces or free-build
- **Multiple biomes** — Forest, desert, arctic, tropical, and urban themes
- **Character placement** — Populate your world with tiny inhabitants
- **Day/night cycle** — Watch your world change with dynamic lighting
- **Export & share** — Save your creation as an image to share with friends

## Why Games on a Tools Platform?

Craftisle is a productivity platform, but creativity needs play. Games serve multiple purposes:

1. **Creative breaks** — 5-10 minutes of creative play between Pomodoro sessions
2. **Design inspiration** — Island Builder as a visual thinking tool
3. **Stress relief** — Building and creating as a form of digital mindfulness
4. **Family-friendly** — Safe, ad-free games suitable for all ages

## The Craftisle Philosophy Applied to Games

Just like our tools, Craftisle games follow the same principles:
- **No account required** — Start playing immediately
- **No downloads** — Everything runs in your browser
- **No tracking** — Your gameplay data stays on your device
- **Free forever** — No in-app purchases, no premium tiers

## Coming Soon

We're actively developing more games for the Craftisle platform:
- **The Last Glimmer** — A narrative survival game set during a storm (in development)
- **Puzzle Collection** — Logic puzzles, word games, and brain teasers
- **Arcade Classics** — Reimagined classic arcade games with modern visuals

## Technical Details

All Craftisle games are built with:
- **HTML5 Canvas/WebGL** — Hardware-accelerated graphics
- **React** — For UI components and game menus
- **TypeScript** — Type-safe game logic
- **Web Audio API** — Immersive sound design
- **localStorage** — Save game progress locally

Play now at [craftisle.com/games](/games) — no download, no signup, just play.

description: Master all 17 Craftisle image tools. Resize, crop, compress, convert formats, add watermarks, generate memes, create pixel art, and more — all in your browser with zero uploads.

body.raw:
Craftisle's image tool suite is one of the most comprehensive collections of **free online image editors** available. Every tool runs entirely in your browser using WebAssembly and modern Canvas APIs — no files are ever uploaded to a server.

## All 17 Image Tools

### 1. Image Resizer
Resize images by exact dimensions or percentage. Supports width, height, and fit modes (cover, contain, fill). Perfect for preparing images for web, social media, or print.

### 2. Image Cropper
Interactive crop tool with precise pixel-level control. Drag to select your crop area and export in any format. Built on react-image-crop for smooth interactions.

### 3. Image Compressor
Reduce file size while maintaining quality. Adjustable compression levels with real-time preview. Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF output formats.

### 4. Image Converter
Convert between image formats instantly. Supported formats: **JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, BMP**. Batch conversion support with quality control.

### 5. Image Rotator
Rotate images by any angle — not just 90° increments. Flip horizontally or vertically. Real-time preview before export.

### 6. Color Palette Extractor
Extract the dominant color palette from any image. Returns hex codes and color distribution data. Great for brand color extraction and design inspiration.

### 7. Favicon Generator
Generate favicon sets from any image. Creates multiple sizes (16×16, 32×32, 48×48, 64×64, 128×128, 256×256) plus Apple touch icons. Perfect for websites and PWA manifest.

### 8. Strip Metadata
Remove EXIF, GPS, camera info, and other metadata from images. Essential for privacy before sharing photos online. Batch processing supported.

### 9. Image Info
View detailed image properties — dimensions, format, file size, color depth, metadata, and EXIF data. Quick inspection without opening an image editor.

### 10. Image Border
Add customizable borders to images. Control border width, color, and style. Perfect for framing photos or creating consistent image styling.

### 11. Watermark
Add text watermarks to protect your images. Customize font, size, color, opacity, and position. Ideal for photographers and content creators.

### 12. Color Adjust
Fine-tune brightness, contrast, saturation, and hue. Real-time preview with sliders for each parameter. Non-destructive editing.

### 13. Passport Photo Generator
Create passport and visa photos that meet official requirements. Automatic face detection, background removal, and size compliance for multiple countries.

### 14. Meme Generator
Create custom memes with top and bottom text. Classic meme formatting with font controls. Add your own images or use templates.

### 15. Beautify Screenshots
Transform plain screenshots into polished marketing images. Add shadows, rounded corners, backgrounds, and padding. Perfect for documentation and social media.

### 16. Find Duplicates
Detect duplicate or near-duplicate images using perceptual hashing (pHash). Compare image content regardless of resolution or minor edits. Batch scan entire folders.

### 17. Create GIF
Combine multiple images into animated GIFs. Control frame delay, loop count, and output quality. Create simple animations without specialized software.

## Image Tools vs PDF Tools

While Craftisle Image Tools handle raster and vector image operations, for document-level image tasks you may want to use our [PDF Tools](https://pdf.craftisle.com):

| Need | Use |
|------|-----|
| Edit a single image | Image Tools |
| Convert images to PDF | PDF Tools → JPG/PNG to PDF |
| Extract images from PDF | PDF Tools → Extract Images |
| Watermark PDF pages | PDF Tools → Add Watermark |
| Compress scanned documents | PDF Tools → Compress PDF |

## Tips for Best Results

1. **Use WebP for web** — WebP offers 25-35% smaller files than JPEG at the same quality
2. **Strip metadata before sharing** — Remove GPS coordinates and camera info for privacy
3. **Compress before uploading** — Reduce file size before uploading to websites or social media
4. **Convert to AVIF for next-gen web** — AVIF provides even better compression than WebP
5. **Use perceptual hashing for dedup** — Find duplicates even when images have been resized or lightly edited

## All Tools Work Offline

Since all processing happens in your browser, Craftisle Image Tools continue to work even without an internet connection after the initial page load. This makes them ideal for:
- Working on sensitive documents
- Editing images while traveling
- Processing files in secure environments

Visit [craftisle.com/tools?category=image](/tools?category=image) to start using all image tools now.

title: Network Tools on Craftisle — IP Calculator, Subnet Planner & User-Agent Parser
description: Free network tools for developers and DevOps. IPv4/IPv6 subnet calculator with CIDR support, user-agent parser for browser analytics. All client-side, instant results.

body.raw:
Craftisle's network tools provide essential networking utilities that every developer and DevOps engineer needs — running 100% in your browser with zero network calls to our servers.

## All 3 Network Tools

### 1. IP Calculator

A full-featured IPv4 and IPv6 subnet calculator that shows everything you need for network planning:

**IPv4 Features:**
- **CIDR notation support** — Enter `192.168.1.0/24` and get instant results
- **Subnet mask input** — Also accepts traditional mask format (`255.255.255.0`)
- **Network address** — The base address of the subnet
- **Broadcast address** — The all-hosts broadcast address
- **Usable host range** — First and last assignable IPs
- **Total hosts** — Including network and broadcast addresses
- **Wildcard mask** — For ACL and OSPF configurations
- **Binary representation** — See the actual bit patterns

**IPv6 Features:**
- Full IPv6 address parsing with shorthand expansion
- Prefix length support (`/32`, `/48`, `/64`, etc.)
- IPv6 subnet calculation with correct EUI-64 conventions

**Real-world use cases:**
- Planning AWS VPC subnets (`/16` to `/28` ranges)
- Configuring firewall allow/deny rules with correct CIDR blocks
- Setting up Kubernetes pod and service CIDR ranges
- Network documentation and architecture diagrams

### 2. IP & Radix Converter

A dual-purpose tool that combines IP conversion with base/radix conversion:

**IP Conversion:**
- IPv4 to decimal, hex, binary, and octal
- IPv6 to full hex and compressed formats
- Reverse: enter decimal and get dotted-decimal IP

**Radix Converter:**
- Convert numbers between bases 2 (binary) through 36
- Live preview as you type
- Support for large integers (BigInt)
- Useful for: understanding bitmasks, encoding IDs, and working with non-decimal number systems

### 3. User-Agent Parser

Parse and analyze browser user-agent strings to understand your visitors' environment:

**What it extracts:**
- **Browser** — Name, version, and rendering engine (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- **Operating System** — Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android with version
- **Device type** — Desktop, tablet, mobile, bot/crawler
- **CPU architecture** — x86, ARM, Apple Silicon
- **Layout engine** — Blink, Gecko, WebKit

**Why it matters:**
- Debug browser-specific bugs by identifying the exact browser/OS combination
- Test responsive design breakpoints based on device type
- Understand your analytics data by parsing raw user-agent strings
- Identify bot traffic patterns in your access logs

## Network Tools in Your Workflow

| Scenario | Tool to Use |
|----------|-------------|
| Planning cloud VPC subnets | IP Calculator |
| Writing firewall rules | IP Calculator (CIDR notation) |
| Debugging a user's browser issue | User-Agent Parser |
| Converting between number bases | IP & Radix Converter |
| Setting up Docker network ranges | IP Calculator |
| Identifying crawler traffic | User-Agent Parser |

## Security & Privacy

All IP calculations and user-agent parsing happen entirely in your browser. No network data is sent to any server. This is critical because:
- Subnet configurations may reveal internal network topology
- User-agent strings can contain identifying information
- All computation is local — instant results, zero latency

Visit [craftisle.com/tools?category=network](/tools?category=network) to start using all network tools.

title: PDF & File Tools on Craftisle — 67 PDF Utilities + 100 Format Viewer
description: Complete guide to Craftisle PDF Tools and File Viewer. Merge, split, compress, OCR, sign, convert 20+ formats, and preview 100+ file types — all in your browser with zero uploads.

body.raw:
Craftisle's PDF and file handling capabilities are split across two specialized subdomains: **pdf.craftisle.com** (67 PDF tools) and **viewer.craftisle.com** (100+ format viewer). Together they cover virtually every document workflow you'll encounter.

## PDF Tools (pdf.craftisle.com)

All 67 PDF tools run on **WebAssembly** via pdf-lib and qpdf.wasm — meaning your documents are processed entirely in your browser. No file uploads, no server processing, no privacy concerns.

### Organize & Manage (24 tools)

**Core Operations:**
- **PDF Multi-Tool** — All-in-one merge, split, organize, rotate, extract, and delete pages
- **Merge PDF** — Combine up to 100 PDFs with drag-and-drop reordering
- **Split PDF** — Split by page ranges or extract individual pages
- **Extract Pages** — Select specific pages with preview thumbnails
- **Organize PDF** — Rearrange, duplicate, and delete pages with visual grid
- **Delete Pages** — Remove unwanted pages with multi-select

**Advanced Operations:**
- **OCR PDF** — Optical character recognition for scanned documents (multi-language)
- **Alternate Merge** — Interleave pages from two PDFs
- **Add/Extract/Edit Attachments** — Embed and manage file attachments
- **Divide Pages** — Split each page horizontally or vertically
- **Rotate Custom** — Rotate by any angle, not just 90° increments
- **Overlay PDF** — Layer one PDF on top of another
- **N-Up Layout** — Print multiple pages per sheet (2-up, 4-up, 6-up, 9-up)
- **Grid Combine** — Arrange multiple PDFs in a custom grid layout
- **Booklet Maker** — Create print-ready booklets with saddle stitch

**Utility:**
- **Add Page Labels** — Roman numerals, prefixes, custom ranges
- **View/Edit Metadata** — Title, author, subject, keywords
- **Posterize PDF** — Split large pages into printable tiles
- **Compare PDFs** — Side-by-side or overlay comparison with diff highlighting

### Edit & Annotate (16 tools)

- **Edit PDF** — Full annotation suite: highlight, underline, strikethrough, shapes, freehand, images, search
- **Sign PDF** — Draw, type, or upload signatures. Multiple signatures per document
- **Crop PDF** — Trim margins across all or selected pages
- **Bookmark Editor** — Add, edit, import, and export PDF bookmarks
- **Table of Contents** — Generate TOC from bookmarks with custom styling
- **Page Numbers** — Add page numbers with custom position, format, and start number
- **Watermark** — Text or image watermarks with opacity, rotation, and position control
- **Header/Footer** — Custom headers and footers with text, dates, and page numbers
- **Form Filler** — Fill PDF forms with XFA support. Save and flatten after filling
- **Form Creator** — Create fillable forms with text fields, checkboxes, and dropdowns
- **Remove Annotations** — Clean up commented PDFs
- **Remove Blank Pages** — Auto-detect and delete empty pages

### Format Conversion (31 tools)

**To PDF (18 input formats):**
JPG, PNG, WebP, SVG, BMP, HEIC, TIFF, Word (DOCX/DOC), Excel (XLSX/XLS), PowerPoint (PPTX/PPT), XPS, RTF, EPUB, MOBI, DjVu, FB2, Markdown, Email (EML/MSG), CBZ

**From PDF (13 output formats):**
JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, SVG, Word (DOCX), Excel (XLSX), PowerPoint (PPTX), JSON, Markdown, CBZ, Greyscale PDF

**Special:**
- **Extract Images** — Export all images from a PDF as ZIP
- **Extract Tables** — Extract tabular data to JSON, Markdown, or CSV
- **AI PDF Reflower** — Intelligent reflow for mobile reading with layout recognition
- **Vector Extractor** — Extract vector graphics as SVG

### Optimize & Repair (10 tools)

- **Compress PDF** — Reduce file size with image optimization and metadata removal
- **Fix Page Size** — Standardize to A4, Letter, Legal, or custom dimensions
- **Linearize PDF** — Optimize for fast web viewing (byte-serving)
- **Repair PDF** — Fix corrupted files and recover data
- **Deskew PDF** — Auto-straighten scanned documents
- **PDF to PDF/A** — Convert to archive-standard PDF/A-1b, 2b, or 3b with font embedding
- **Font to Outline** — Convert all text to vector paths for guaranteed rendering
- **OCG Layer Manager** — View, toggle, add, and delete optional content layers
- **Deep Sanitize** — Remove all metadata, incremental updates, and hidden watermarks

### Security (9 tools)

- **Encrypt PDF** — Password protection with AES encryption and permission controls
- **Decrypt PDF** — Remove password protection (if you have the password)
- **Sanitize PDF** — Strip metadata, annotations, scripts, and attachments
- **Find and Redact** — Search and permanently remove sensitive text
- **Flatten PDF** — Make annotations and form fields permanent
- **Change Permissions** — Set printing, copying, and editing restrictions
- **Digital Sign** — X.509 certificate signing (PFX/P12/PEM) with visible signature
- **Validate Signature** — Verify digital signatures and certificate chains
- **Timestamp PDF** — RFC 3161 trusted timestamping for audit trails

---

## File Viewer (viewer.craftisle.com)

Preview **100+ file formats** directly in your browser. Five specialized viewers for different content types.

### PDF Viewer
Full-featured PDF reader with page navigation, zoom (25%-500%), rotation, search, fullscreen mode, and direct download. Renders complex documents with vector graphics and embedded fonts.

### DOCX Viewer
View Word documents with preserved formatting — headers, lists, tables, images, and text styling. No Microsoft Office installation needed.

### XLSX Viewer
Preview Excel spreadsheets with formula evaluation, multiple sheets, merged cells, and conditional formatting. Read-only view for quick data inspection.

### PPTX Viewer
View PowerPoint presentations with slide navigation, animations, speaker notes, and fullscreen presentation mode.

### 3D & CAD Viewer
Interactive 3D model viewing with orbit, pan, and zoom controls. Supported formats:
- **STL, OBJ, PLY** — Standard 3D mesh formats
- **GLTF, GLB** — Modern glTF 2.0 with PBR materials
- **3MF, AMF** — 3D printing formats
- **DWG, DXF** — AutoCAD and CAD exchange formats
- **DAE, FBX** — Collada and Autodesk formats

### Image & Code Viewer
- **Images:** PNG, JPG, GIF, SVG, WebP, BMP, ICO, PSD, AI
- **Code:** JSON, XML, YAML, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python
- **Data:** CSV, TSV

---

## Why Client-Side Processing Matters

**Privacy:** Your documents never leave your device. Perfect for:
- Legal documents and contracts
- Financial statements and tax records
- Medical records and personal information
- Proprietary business documents

**Speed:** No upload/download waiting time. Processing starts instantly.

**No Limits:** No file size caps, no daily quotas, no usage limits. Process as many files as you need.

**Offline Capable:** PDF tools and file viewer continue working without internet after initial page load.

---

## Workflow Examples

### Compress and Share a PDF
1. Open [PDF Compress](https://pdf.craftisle.com/compress-pdf)
2. Upload your PDF (up to 100 files)
3. Adjust compression level
4. Download the optimized file

### Merge Multiple PDFs
1. Open [Merge PDF](https://pdf.craftisle.com/merge-pdf)
2. Drag and drop files in desired order
3. Click Merge
4. Download combined PDF

### Preview a CAD File
1. Open [viewer.craftisle.com](https://viewer.craftisle.com)
2. Upload your DWG/DXF/STL file
3. Rotate, zoom, and inspect the model
4. No CAD software needed

---

Start exploring: [PDF Tools](https://pdf.craftisle.com) | [File Viewer](https://viewer.craftisle.com)

title: Privacy & Security at Craftisle — How We Protect Your Data
description: Understand Craftisle's privacy-first architecture. All tools run client-side with zero data collection. No accounts, no tracking, no server uploads. How we keep your data truly private.

body.raw:
Privacy isn't a feature at Craftisle — it's the foundation. Every design decision starts with one question: "Can we do this without touching the user's data?" The answer is almost always yes.

## The Architecture of Privacy

### Client-Side Processing

The vast majority of Craftisle tools process data entirely in your browser:

- **Image tools** — Canvas API and Web Workers handle all pixel manipulation locally
- **PDF tools** — pdf-lib and qpdf.wasm compile to WebAssembly and run in-browser
- **Encryption tools** — AES, bcrypt, and hashing use the Web Crypto API
- **Formatters & converters** — Plain JavaScript string and data transformations
- **File viewer** — Local file rendering via FlyFish engine (no upload)
- **Resume builder** — All data stored in localStorage only

### What "Client-Side" Actually Means

When we say "client-side," we mean:
1. Your file is read by your browser using the FileReader API
2. Processing happens in JavaScript/WebAssembly in your browser's memory
3. The result is written back to your downloads folder
4. **At no point does your data leave your device**

### Server-Side Exceptions (Minimal & Documented)

A few tools require brief server processing for functionality that can't be done client-side:

| Tool | What's sent | Why | Retention |
|------|-------------|-----|-----------|
| Image Resizer | Image file | Sharp (server-side library) produces higher quality than Canvas | Deleted after processing |
| QR Code Generator | URL/Text to encode | QR code generation library runs server-side | Not stored |
| OCR PDF | PDF file | Tesseract.js can be too slow client-side for large documents | Deleted after OCR |

All server-processed files are:
- Transmitted over HTTPS only
- Processed in memory (not written to disk)
- Deleted immediately after processing completes
- Never shared with third parties

## Data We Don't Collect

Craftisle is built to function with **zero personal data collection**:

- ❌ No user accounts — no email, no password, no profile data
- ❌ No analytics on tool usage — we don't know which tools you use
- ❌ No file content logging — we can't see your documents
- ❌ No IP address logging for tool usage
- ❌ No cookies for tracking (only essential functional cookies)
- ❌ No third-party trackers, pixels, or fingerprinting scripts

### What We Do Collect (Minimal & Transparent)

The only data we collect is anonymous, aggregated page view counts — and only for the marketing pages (homepage, blog). We use a privacy-focused analytics tool that:
- Does not use cookies
- Does not track individual users
- Does not collect IP addresses (truncated before storage)
- Provides only aggregate counts (e.g., "500 visitors to /blog today")

## Monetag Ads & Privacy

To keep Craftisle free, we display non-intrusive advertisements via Monetag on some pages. Our ad policy:
- Ads are controlled by an environment variable (`NEXT_PUBLIC_MONETAG_ENABLED`) — easily toggleable
- No personal data is shared with advertisers
- We only use contextual ads (based on page content, not user profiles)
- No ad tracking cookies without explicit consent (where required by law)

## Security Best Practices

### For the Platform
- **CSP (Content Security Policy)** — Strict headers prevent XSS and code injection
- **HTTPS only** — All traffic encrypted with modern TLS (minimum TLS 1.2)
- **Subresource Integrity** — Third-party scripts verified with SRI hashes
- **Regular dependency audits** — Automated vulnerability scanning via Dependabot
- **No external CDN for core assets** — Self-hosted to avoid supply chain attacks

### For Users
We recommend these practices when using Craftisle (or any online tool):
1. **Verify HTTPS** — Always check for the lock icon in your browser
2. **Use incognito mode** — For extra-sensitive documents
3. **Clear localStorage** — If you use the Resume Builder, clear data when done on shared computers
4. **Check file permissions** — Downloaded files inherit your OS permissions

## Legal Pages

We maintain comprehensive legal documentation:
- **[Privacy Policy](/privacy)** — Detailed data handling practices
- **[Terms of Service](/terms)** — Usage terms and conditions
- **[Cookie Policy](/cookie-policy)** — How and why we use cookies
- **[Disclaimer](/disclaimer)** — Limitations of liability and tool accuracy

## Open Source Commitment

Craftisle's source code is publicly available on GitHub. You can:
- **Audit our privacy claims** — Every line of code is visible
- **Self-host** — Run your own instance if you prefer
- **Contribute** — Help us improve privacy and security

## Our Promise

We built Craftisle because we believe tools should be free, private, and accessible to everyone. We will never:
- Sell or share your data (we don't have it)
- Add mandatory accounts or signup walls
- Introduce tracking or analytics on tool pages
- Store your files on our servers
- Change our privacy model without transparent communication

If you have questions about privacy or security, contact us at [craftisle.com/contact](/contact).

title: Craftisle Resource Directory — 10,000+ Free Developer Resources
description: Explore Craftisle's curated resource directory with 10,000+ free tools, APIs, libraries, and self-hosted solutions. Organized across 40+ categories. The ultimate developer resource hub.

body.raw:
The Craftisle Resource Directory is the most comprehensive curated collection of free developer resources on the web — **10,129 resources** across 40+ categories, sourced and verified from the community's best lists.

## What's in the Directory?

### Categories at a Glance

The directory organizes resources into 12 major domains, each with detailed subcategories:

| Domain | Resources | Highlights |
|--------|-----------|------------|
| **Development** | 2,000+ | APIs, IDEs, code editors, CI/CD, testing, monitoring |
| **Infrastructure** | 1,500+ | Cloud, containers, databases, networking, security |
| **Design** | 800+ | UI kits, icons, fonts, color tools, prototyping |
| **Content** | 1,200+ | CMS, static site generators, documentation, blogging |
| **Media** | 900+ | Image editing, video tools, audio, 3D modeling |
| **Data & Analytics** | 700+ | Databases, analytics, visualization, data processing |
| **Productivity** | 800+ | Note-taking, project management, automation, collaboration |
| **Developer Tools** | 1,000+ | Code formatting, diff tools, regex, encoding, debugging |
| **Security** | 500+ | Encryption, authentication, vulnerability scanning, pentesting |
| **AI & ML** | 600+ | LLMs, model hosting, vector databases, AI agents |
| **Finance & Crypto** | 400+ | Payment processing, crypto tools, trading, accounting |
| **Education** | 729+ | Courses, tutorials, documentation, reference materials |

### Data Sources

The directory aggregates and curates resources from four major open-source lists:

1. **FMHY (6,187 resources)** — The largest community-maintained collection of free resources
2. **Free-for.dev (57 categories)** — SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS offerings with free tiers
3. **Awesome Self-Hosted (83 categories)** — Self-hosted alternatives to popular SaaS products
4. **Public APIs (51 categories)** — Free APIs for development and testing

Each resource is verified for:
- Active maintenance and recent updates
- Genuinely free offering (not just a free trial)
- Community reputation and GitHub stars (where applicable)
- Quality of documentation and developer experience

## How to Use the Directory

### Browse by Domain

Start by selecting a domain that matches your needs. Each domain page shows:
- All subcategories with resource counts
- Top-rated and most popular resources
- Recently added and updated entries
- Quick filters for platform, pricing model, and license type

### Search with Filters

The advanced search supports:
- **Keyword search** — Find resources by name, description, or tags
- **Category filter** — Narrow by domain and subcategory
- **Source filter** — Filter by data source (FMHY, Free-for.dev, etc.)
- **Sort options** — By popularity, rating, or recency

### Resource Detail Pages

Each resource has a dedicated page with:
- **Full description** — What it does and why it's useful
- **Pricing details** — Free tier limits and paid plan info
- **Alternatives** — Similar resources for comparison
- **External links** — Direct links to the resource and its documentation
- **Community notes** — Tips and caveats from the community

## Why This Directory Matters

### For Developers
- **Save hours of Googling** — Find the right tool in seconds instead of reading forum threads
- **Discover alternatives** — When a popular tool goes paid, find free replacements
- **Stay updated** — New resources added regularly from community submissions

### For Startups
- **Reduce SaaS costs** — Find free-tier tools that replace expensive subscriptions
- **Choose the right stack** — Compare options across categories before committing
- **Self-host to save** — Discover self-hosted alternatives to SaaS products

### For Students
- **Free learning resources** — 729+ educational resources, all free
- **Build a portfolio** — Find free hosting, domains, and development tools
- **Experiment freely** — No credit card required for any listed resource

## Integration with Craftisle Tools

The directory complements Craftisle's built-in tools:

| If you're looking for | Check the directory for |
|----------------------|------------------------|
| Image editing alternatives | Media → Image Editing |
| PDF tool supplements | Content → PDF Tools |
| Development tool ecosystem | Developer Tools |
| AI-powered alternatives | AI & ML |
| Self-hosted versions | Infrastructure → Self-Hosted |

## Community Contributions

The directory is a living resource. You can:
- **Submit new resources** — Suggest additions via GitHub
- **Report issues** — Flag outdated or broken links
- **Write reviews** — Share your experience with listed resources
- **Suggest categories** — Propose new domains or subcategories

Start exploring at [craftisle.com/directory](/directory) — your one-stop hub for free developer resources.

title: Craftisle Resume Builder — Create Professional Resumes 100% Private
description: Build ATS-friendly resumes with Craftisle's free resume builder. Rich text editing, 15+ section types, multiple templates, PDF/DOCX export. All data stored locally — no account required.

body.raw:
The Craftisle Resume Builder ([resume.craftisle.com](https://resume.craftisle.com)) is a privacy-first, feature-rich resume creation tool built on Reactive Resume. Unlike most resume builders, every piece of data stays in your browser's localStorage — no account, no cloud storage, no data collection.

## Why a Resume Builder on Craftisle?

Most online resume builders require you to create an account, upload your data to their servers, and often lock exporting behind a paywall. Craftisle's approach is fundamentally different:

- **Zero data collection** — Your resume data never leaves your browser
- **No account required** — Start building immediately
- **Free PDF/DOCX export** — No watermarks, no page limits, no paywalls
- **Full offline support** — Edit your resume without internet after initial load

## Key Features

### Rich Text Editing

Every section supports rich text formatting:
- **Bold, italic, underline, strikethrough**
- **Font sizes and colors**
- **Bullet and numbered lists**
- **Hyperlinks** — Link to your portfolio, GitHub, LinkedIn
- **Date ranges** — Automatic formatting for employment periods

### 15+ Section Types

Build a comprehensive resume with any combination of:
- **Contact Information** — Name, email, phone, location, website, social profiles
- **Professional Summary** — A compelling headline and summary paragraph
- **Work Experience** — Multiple positions with company, title, dates, and description
- **Education** — Degrees, certifications, GPA, coursework
- **Skills** — Technical skills, soft skills, languages (with proficiency levels)
- **Projects** — Portfolio projects with links and descriptions
- **Awards & Certifications** — Professional certifications and achievements
- **Publications** — Research papers, articles, books
- **Volunteer Experience** — Community involvement and volunteer work
- **References** — Professional references with contact information
- **Custom Sections** — Create any section type you need

### Multiple Templates

Choose from professionally designed templates optimized for:
- **ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems)** — Clean layouts that parse correctly
- **Creative roles** — More visual layouts for designers and artists
- **Technical roles** — Skills-forward layouts for developers and engineers
- **Executive roles** — Traditional formats for senior positions

### Export Options

- **PDF export** — Print-ready, ATS-optimized PDFs with embedded fonts
- **DOCX export** — Editable Word documents for further customization
- **Real-time preview** — See exactly how your resume will look before exporting

### Privacy Architecture

The Resume Builder's privacy model is built on localStorage:

1. All resume data is stored in your browser's localStorage
2. No cookies, no tracking scripts, no analytics on your data
3. You can export your data as JSON and import it on another device
4. Clear your browser data, and your resume data is gone — no server copies exist

## How It Compares

| Feature | Craftisle Resume | LinkedIn Resume | Canva | Novorésumé |
|---------|-----------------|-----------------|-------|------------|
| Account Required | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Data Privacy | Local only | Cloud stored | Cloud stored | Cloud stored |
| Free PDF Export | Yes | Yes | Watermark | Limited |
| Templates | Multiple | 1 | 100+ | 10+ |
| ATS Optimized | Yes | Basic | No | Yes |
| Offline Support | Yes | No | No | No |

## Getting Started

1. Visit [resume.craftisle.com](https://resume.craftisle.com)
2. Start adding sections — your data saves automatically
3. Switch templates to find your preferred layout
4. Export to PDF or DOCX when ready

## Tips for an Effective Resume

1. **Tailor for ATS** — Use keywords from the job description in your skills and experience sections
2. **Quantify achievements** — "Increased revenue by 30%" beats "Responsible for revenue growth"
3. **Keep it concise** — Aim for 1 page (early career) or 2 pages (10+ years experience)
4. **Use action verbs** — "Designed", "Implemented", "Led", "Optimized"
5. **Proofread** — Use the Text Diff tool to compare versions after edits

Visit [resume.craftisle.com](https://resume.craftisle.com) to build your resume now — completely free, completely private.

title: Text Tools on Craftisle — Case Converter, Diff Checker, Unicode & More
description: Master Craftisle's 4 text tools. Case converter for all naming conventions, side-by-side diff checker, Unicode inspector, and multi-function text formatter. All free, browser-based.

body.raw:
Craftisle's text tools are designed for developers and writers who need quick, reliable text manipulation without installing software. Every tool runs entirely in your browser — no data leaves your device.

## All 4 Text Tools

### 1. Case Converter

Instantly convert text between **all major naming conventions**. Paste once, get all formats simultaneously:

| Format | Example | Common Use |
|--------|---------|-----------|
| **camelCase** | `myVariableName` | JavaScript, Java, Go |
| **PascalCase** | `MyClassName` | C#, TypeScript classes, React components |
| **snake_case** | `my_variable_name` | Python, Ruby, Rust, SQL column names |
| **CONSTANT_CASE** | `MY_CONSTANT` | Environment variables, C/C++ constants |
| **kebab-case** | `my-variable-name` | CSS classes, URLs, CLI flags |
| **dot.case** | `my.variable.name` | Configuration keys, Java packages |

**Why you need it:** Moving code between Python (snake_case) and JavaScript (camelCase) is a daily friction for full-stack developers. One paste, one click — all conventions at once.

### 2. Text Formatter

A Swiss Army knife for text with **20+ operations** in a single tool:

- **Word & character count** — Quick statistics for writers and content editors
- **Sort lines** — Alphabetical, reverse, or by length
- **Remove duplicates** — Deduplicate email lists, URLs, product SKUs
- **Trim whitespace** — Remove leading/trailing spaces, normalize line endings
- **Find and replace** — Full regex support for power users
- **Add prefixes/suffixes** — Batch-prepend or append text to every line
- **Number lines** — Add sequential line numbers for code snippets
- **Wrap text** — Reflow long paragraphs to a specified width

**Pro tip:** Use the regex find-and-replace to convert between log formats, clean CSV exports, or normalize API responses in seconds.

### 3. Text Diff

Compare two texts side-by-side with **color-coded differences** using Myers' diff algorithm — the same one Git uses:

- **Side-by-side view** — See original and modified text in parallel panels
- **Inline view** — Differences highlighted within a single unified view
- **Word-level diff** — Highlight changed words, not just entire lines
- **Character-level diff** — For fine-grained comparison of short strings
- **Ignorable whitespace** — Toggle to focus on meaningful changes only
- **Export diff** — Download as a unified diff patch file

**Use cases:**
- Compare configuration files between staging and production
- Review code changes before committing
- Spot differences between contract versions or legal documents
- Debug why an API response changed between deployments

### 4. Unicode Inspector

Explore, search, and convert Unicode characters with full metadata:

- **Character lookup** — Search by name, code point, or paste any character
- **Code point details** — View UTF-8 bytes, UTF-16 bytes, category, block, and script
- **Format conversion** — Convert between `\uXXXX`, `&#xXXXX;`, `U+XXXX`, and raw characters
- **Bidirectional info** — Check if a character is LTR, RTL, or neutral (critical for Arabic/Hebrew layouts)
- **Emoji support** — Full emoji sequence parsing including skin tones, flags, and ZWJ sequences

**Real-world debugging:** When your app shows `□` instead of a character, paste it into the Unicode inspector to see exactly which code point is missing from your font. This tool has saved countless hours debugging CJK, emoji, and RTL text rendering issues.

| Convert naming conventions | Case Converter |
| Clean and format bulk text | Text Formatter |
| Compare two versions | Text Diff |
| Debug encoding issues | Unicode Inspector |
| Format JSON/YAML/SQL | Formatters (separate category) |
| Encrypt text | AES/DES Encrypt |

## Privacy Guarantee

All text processing runs entirely in your browser. Your text data never touches a Craftisle server — even during diff comparison, format conversion, or Unicode inspection. This makes these tools safe for:
- Proprietary source code
- Confidential documents and contracts
- PII (Personally Identifiable Information)
- API keys and credentials

title: Utility Tools on Craftisle — Pomodoro Timer, Stopwatch, Countdown & More
description: 7 free utility tools for productivity and decision making. Pomodoro timer, precise stopwatch, event countdown, coin flip, wheel spinner, scoreboard, and counter. All free, no signup.

body.raw:
Craftisle's utility tools are designed for everyday productivity — timers, counters, and decision-making helpers that you can reach for in seconds. Every tool works offline after initial page load.

## All 7 Utility Tools

### 1. Pomodoro Timer

A full Pomodoro Technique implementation with customizable intervals:

- **Default cycle:** 25 min work → 5 min short break → repeat 4× → 15 min long break
- **Customizable durations** — Adjust work, short break, and long break lengths
- **Session tracking** — Count completed pomodoros per day
- **Desktop notifications** — Alert even when the tab is in the background
- **Audio alerts** — Distinct sounds for work start, break start, and cycle complete

**The science:** The Pomodoro Technique leverages your brain's ultradian rhythm by breaking work into manageable 25-minute chunks. After 4 cycles (about 2 hours), a longer break prevents mental fatigue.

### 2. Stopwatch

A high-precision stopwatch using `performance.now()` for microsecond accuracy:

- **Millisecond display** — HH:MM:SS.mmm format
- **Lap timing** — Record up to 99 split times without stopping
- **Background timing** — Keeps running even when you switch tabs (Web Worker API)
- **Fullscreen mode** — Large display for presentations or sports timing

**Use cases:** Athletic timing, productivity measurement, science experiments, cooking competitions.

### 3. Countdown Timer

Set custom countdowns for events, deadlines, or timed activities:

- **Flexible input** — Set hours, minutes, and seconds independently
- **Visual progress bar** — See remaining time at a glance
- **Alarm with tab flash** — Impossible to miss when time is up
- **Preset durations** — Quick-set buttons for 1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 25, 30, 60 minutes

### 4. Coin Flip

A virtual coin toss using cryptographic randomness (`Crypto.getRandomValues()`):

- **True 50/50 probability** — No pseudo-random bias
- **Realistic animation** — Coin spin with satisfying visual feedback
- **Statistics tracking** — Heads/tails count and percentage over time
- **Sound effect** — Optional coin flip audio

### 5. Wheel Spinner

A customizable prize wheel for random selections:

- **Add custom entries** — Name your own wheel segments
- **Remove/Edit entries** — Modify the wheel on the fly
- **Smooth spin animation** — With easing for dramatic reveals
- **History tracking** — See previous spin results

**Perfect for:** Classroom activities, giveaway drawings, team assignment randomization, decision making with more than 2 options.

### 6. Scoreboard

A digital score counter for games and competitions:

- **Multiple players/teams** — Add as many as you need
- **Increment/Decrement** — Adjust scores easily
- **Custom labels** — Name your players or teams
- **Reset all** — Quick reset for new games

### 7. Counter

A simple tally counter with persistent storage:

- **Increment/Decrement** — Click buttons or use arrow keys
- **Custom step size** — Count by 1, 5, 10, or any number
- **Session persistence** — Counter value saved in localStorage
- **Large display** — Easy to read from a distance

**Use cases:** Gym rep tracking, inventory counting, event attendance, knitting row counting.

## Productivity Stack

Combine these tools for a complete productivity workflow:

1. **Start a Pomodoro** (25 min focus session)
2. **Use the Stopwatch** to track how long specific tasks take
3. **Set a Countdown** for meeting timeboxes
4. **Track completed Pomodoros** with the Counter
5. **Use Coin Flip or Wheel** for break-time decisions

## Offline-Ready

All utility tools use client-side timers (`setInterval`/`requestAnimationFrame`/Web Workers) and local storage. They continue working without internet after the initial page load, making them reliable even in:
- Airplane mode
- Unstable connections
- Secure environments without internet access

Start using all utilities at [craftisle.com/tools?category=utility](/tools?category=utility).
